audit_name: RoadTwin AI Live Provider Security & Redaction Audit

server_side_key_isolation.detail: TOMTOM_API_KEY is read server-side via scripts/config.py and is never exported to frontend environment variables.

api_response_concealment.detail: Zero API keys, tokens, or credentials are returned in any REST JSON payload (/system/status, /system/readiness, /state).

logging_redaction.detail: API keys are excluded from structured logging formats and exception traces.

frontend_bundle_cleanliness.detail: Next.js 15 production build (.next/) verified clean with zero embedded secrets.
